answer: Farming becomes a wander bet on surviving 101 epochs of grading, and every zenith settlement recomputes the mesa schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 101 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 37 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
